description: Extract structured data from repeated elements. For each element matching the outer selector, extracts named fields using sub-selectors. Returns JSON array of objects.

attribute.description: Optional attribute to extract instead of text content.

selector.description: CSS selector relative to the container element.

fields.description: Map of field names to extraction rules. Each rule has a "selector" (relative CSS selector) and optional "attribute".

selector.description: CSS selector for the repeating container elements (e.g., "table tbody tr", ".card").

tab.description: The tab to drive: a handle of this session such as "t2" (list_tabs, new_tab). Default: the session's current tab.

name: extract_map
